text: In 19th century Switzerland, Baron Victor Frankenstein awaits [the guillotine|images|ropes, cages and executions] and tells a visiting priest his story. With his tutor Paul Krempe he revives a dead puppy, then sets out to [build a perfect human from body parts|threat|science playing god], taking a robber's corpse from a gibbet and [killing an ageing professor for his brain|wrong|a life taken]. The damaged brain leaves the creature violent, yet Victor keeps reviving it while [his fiancée Elizabeth|who_suffers|spouses and lovers] lives under the same roof.
